name: Korg PS-3300
description: Korg PS-3300 (2026), the PSU-3302 by control change and each of its three PSU-3301 units by NRPN, with its program dump.

sources.title: PS-3300 MIDI Implementation (Revision 1.00, 2026.06.18)
sources.notes: Tables read by tools/profiles/korg/read-korg-text.mjs from PS-3300_MIDIImp.txt (sha256 7107b6d9bc8e0c912977e20d46ef2e358ecfde48b52815ed01e1e0b504dc8061), https://www.korg.com/us/support/download/manual/0/991/5695/. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/korg/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/korg/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a control change the document says the instrument recognises, or a row of its NRPN table, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Not a parameter here, Bank Select, part of preset recall: CC 0, 32.
Not a parameter here, Data Entry, part of the NRPN messages: CC 6.
Not a parameter here, an NRPN or RPN selector, part of the NRPN messages: CC 98, 99.
Not a parameter here, a channel mode message: CC 120, 123.
The NRPN MSB picks the unit (0 = PSU-3301 RIGHT, 1 = PSU-3301 CENTER, 2 = PSU-3301 LEFT) and the LSB its setting: 43 settings for each.

Pull: CURRENT PROGRAM DATA DUMP REQUEST, answered by the current program in Korg's 8-in-7 packing (732Bytes (7bit) -> 640Bytes (8bit)). 141 parameter(s) are read back from it by the program table's offsets; a controller parameter reads the top seven bits of its 10-bit field, the value its controller sends.

Two-byte values are read low byte first, the earlier byte holding the low eight bits: the prologue document's own TEMPO settles it (300~6000 as H:0~7 then L:0~4), and the miniKORG 700Sm's document, which prints L first, agrees.
The exclusive header carries the global MIDI channel as 3g; the profile's deviceId variable is that byte, 30H for channel 1.
Not found under its own name in the program dump, so not read back: DAMPER.

In the program dump with no parameter of the same name here: DATA REVISION, MODIFY PSU-3302, PSU-3301 RIGHT : MODIFY PSU-3301, PSU-3301 RIGHT : MODIFY PSU-3301 TUNE, PSU-3301 CENTER : MODIFY PSU-3301, PSU-3301 CENTER : MODIFY PSU-3301 TUNE, PSU-3301 LEFT : MODIFY PSU-3301, PSU-3301 LEFT : MODIFY PSU-3301 TUNE.
